task: Auto-provision a public.sunners row for every Google account at first sign-in (trigger on auth.users + one-time backfill) so any signed-in user can like and write kudos
acceptanceCriteria: A new auth.users row gets exactly one sunners row with user_id = its id, created by an after-insert trigger

full_name follows ALG-007: full_name, else name, else email local part, else 'Sunner', trimmed and capped at 100 chars; avatar_url is avatar_url else picture only when https and at most 2048 chars, else null
Existing auth users without a sunner are backfilled once by the migration; seeded sunners stay unlinked
The trigger function is SECURITY DEFINER with search_path '' and not executable by public, anon or authenticated; sunners.user_id stays hidden from authenticated
A freshly provisioned user can create a kudo and like a kudo through the existing RPCs; the no-sunner backstop paths still work
Existing pgTAP and e2e suites stay green
contracts: No client grants change; kudos_private functions not exposed
